o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *yẹ̄miĺč (“vegetable, fruit”). Cognate with Chuvash ҫимӗҫ (śimĕś, “vegetable”), Hungarian gyümölcs (“fruit”), etc.
From Classical Persian مزدور, which in turn inherited from Middle Persian [script needed] (myzdwbl /⁠mizdwar⁠/, “hireling, hired laborer”).
Borrowed from Russian шо́у (šóu), from English show.
